page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.18xlarge is an enterprise-class general-purpose instance designed to deliver dedicated processing capability for demanding workloads. Built on the x86_64 CPU architecture and executed via KVM virtualization, it features 72 vCPUs driven by Intel Xeon 8163 processors running at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz. Accompanying the compute foundation is 288 GB of total system RAM, establishing a standard 1:4 core-to-memory allocation ratio with 4.0 GB of memory per individual vCPU.

Network throughput is a key hardware characteristic of the ecs.g5ne.18xlarge, providing a baseline network bandwidth of 33 Gbps. This instance type includes no local storage drives, requiring administrators to rely on remote block storage or external storage services for application data. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent computational output without shared-core resource contention or CPU credit restrictions.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.g5ne.18xlarge offers significant resource density by grouping 72 core allocations and 288 GB of RAM onto a single instance, optimizing infrastructure overhead for large software deployments. Tradeoffs include the absence of integrated local storage drives and hardware accelerators like GPUs. This server type is well suited for general enterprise applications, middle-tier web servers, continuous integration pipelines, and distributed data processing tasks.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.18xlarge is a large-scale general-purpose server instance configured with 72 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs derived from Intel Xeon 8163 processors operating at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The system provides 288 GB of RAM, establishing a 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio equal to 4 GB per core. Operating on a KVM hypervisor, this instance lacks attached local SSD storage, requiring external block or network storage solutions for persistent data needs. It provides a robust baseline network bandwidth of 33 Gbps, facilitating rapid data exchange across distributed environments. The hardware profile offers high resource density suitable for multi-threaded applications, middle-tier enterprise workloads, web serving, and database management. The resource combination delivers continuous dedicated processing capacity without dynamic CPU throttling, providing predictable execution performance for complex software stacks and back-end services.
